name: Delta SkyMiles® Gold American Express Card

tripDelay.notes: Maximum 2 claims per 12-month period. Delay must be 12+ hours or require overnight stay.

tripCancellation.notes: Maximum $20,000 per 12 months across all claims.

lostBaggage.notes: Coverage applies when full fare is charged to card. High-value items (jewelry, electronics) may be subject to sub-limits.

baggageDelay.notes: Coverage after baggage is delayed 6+ hours. Maximum $500 total.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Not a primary benefit on Delta SkyMiles Gold.

emergencyMedical.notes: Global Assist Hotline: 24/7 medical, legal, financial, and other emergency assistance coordination. Emergency medical evacuation coordination — cardholder responsible for costs. Does NOT pay medical treatment expenses.

rentalCarInsurance.countries: US and select international destinations. Excludes certain countries.
rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary coverage — file with personal auto insurance first. Must decline dealer's CDW/LDW.

purchaseProtection.notes: Covers eligible purchases for 90 days from date of purchase.

extendedWarranty.notes: Extends manufacturer's warranty by 1 year on warranties of 5 years or less.

rewards.diningRate: 2x miles at restaurants worldwide including takeout and delivery

pointValue.transferPartners: Delta SkyMiles — 1:1 transfer from Amex Membership Rewards (if linked)

annualCredits.name: Delta Stays Hotel Credit
annualCredits.notes: $200 annual credit on prepaid hotels booked through Delta Stays (deltahotels.com or delta.com/hotels).

freeCheckedBags.notes: First checked bag free for cardholder and up to 8 companions on the same reservation when flying Delta.

inflight.notes: 20% savings on eligible in-flight purchases as a statement credit.

milesRedemptionDiscount.notes: 15% savings when redeeming SkyMiles on Delta flights through delta.com or the Fly Delta app (TakeOff 15).

eliteStatusBenefits.notes: Does not earn Medallion Qualifying Dollars. No automatic Medallion status.

travelPerks: First checked bag free (cardholder + up to 8 companions)
Zone 5 priority boarding on Delta flights
20% savings on in-flight purchases (as statement credit)
15% off SkyMiles redemptions on Delta flights (TakeOff 15)
$100 Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years
Trip delay coverage after 12 hours ($300/trip, 2 claims/year)
Baggage delay coverage up to $500 ($100/day after 6 hours)
Lost baggage up to $1,250 carry-on / $500 checked
bestFor: Delta loyalists seeking free checked bags and priority boarding at a mid-tier annual fee
